text:
jamal: heads up — noticed billing attribution breaks when requests are proxied through our service-proxy across orgs. quota shows on proxy org not caller org. Anyone seen this in prod?
maria: saw it in the soak yesterday. proxy drops the delegated claim header in some paths (envoy sidecar).
alex: we currently prefer token claims, then headers, then proxy identity. but the sidecar rewrite can remove X-Delegated-Project.
leah: for console UX we can't silently switch the billed project. Suggest we surface both: origin_project + executing_project columns in the usage table and an explanatory tooltip.
jamal: the harder issue is billing and quota enforcement need a single canonical project_id. flipping attribution on the fly risks double-counting or missed quota checks.
alex: proposal: deterministic priority order — claim_project > origin_header > proxy_identity. That preserves existing semantics for direct tokens.
maria: agree. Also we need telemetry labels so engineers can see when we fell back. add auth.attribution.path and auth.attribution.origin_project to logs.
leah: UX rollout idea: default to showing final billed project but add a small banner when requests are proxied saying "Some calls routed via proxy; attribution may differ" with a link to docs. Gate via feature flag.
metrics-bot: metric request logged: `auth.attribution.path` (labels: source, final_project, proxy_project). Suggested dashboard tile: "Auth attribution by path".
ops: starting a canary in staging for the attr-priority change. watching billing.rate, quota_denied_count, and auth.failures. Will tag incidents if spikes.
jamal: quick implementation sketch for the config we discussed:
```yaml
auth_priority:
  - claim_project
  - origin_header
  - proxy_identity
```
I'll open a PR with tests and a migration job to backfill logs.
alex: ping me on the PR. I'll add the backfill job to decode historical proxy headers and emit auth.attribution.* for lineage.
maria: also add an audit event whenever attribution uses fallback (origin_header or proxy_identity). SREs will need that to triage.
leah: I can draft the tooltip copy and help wire the console flag. Suggested copy: "Calls routed through intermediaries may be billed to a different project — click to learn why." short and plain.
jamal: perfect. @leah please add that to the copy doc and link to the PR. thanks :pray:
metrics-bot: created ticket INF-1138 for dashboard labels and panel work.
ops: noted — will watch the canary through EOD and post a summary in #release-war-room.
notes: thread focused on attribution rules, telemetry labels, console UX messaging, and a staged rollout plan. brief code/config snippet included. contains bot notes and a ticket link
